definitions.explanation: The compass direction between north and east.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}は{北東|ほくとう}から{吹|ふ}いている。
examples.english: The wind is blowing from the northeast.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{北東|ほくとう}に{公園|こうえん}がある。
examples.english: There is a park to the northeast of the station.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}は{北東|ほくとう}に{進路|しんろ}を{変|か}え、{太平洋|たいへいよう}に{抜|ぬ}ける{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: The typhoon is expected to change course to the northeast and move out over the Pacific Ocean.

notes:
Composed of {北|ほく} (north) + {東|とう} (east). One of the four intercardinal directions. In traditional Japanese geomancy ({家相|かそう}), the northeast direction is called {鬼門|きもん} (demon gate) and is considered an unlucky direction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北東|ほくとう}の{風|かぜ} — northeast wind
- {北東|ほくとう}に{位置|いち}する — to be located to the northeast
- {北東|ほくとう}{方向|ほうこう} — northeast direction
- {北東部|ほくとうぶ} — northeastern part/region

RELATED COMPASS DIRECTIONS:
- {北西|ほくせい} — northwest
- {南東|なんとう} — southeast
- {南西|なんせい} — southwest
